note_tweet.text:
Preparing for the master’s entrance examination always feels like wandering through a thick fog, with the fear of failure and wasted time hanging over you.

I know I need a degree for the career I want. Yet whenever I come across posts celebrating someone else’s admission, that familiar thought returns, cliché as it may sound: I know where I want to go, but I still cannot reach it.

Perhaps that is what makes this period so difficult. I have to keep my attention on everything I still need to review, while somehow preserving enough of myself to keep noticing the beauty of life along the way.
